name: harness
title: Harness designer
description: The wire harness designer, an extension app: place devices on a canvas and wire their connectors pin to pin, with signal rules, pinout tables, versions and ordering the plugs. Its data is in ordinary apps that come with it as templates: Devices (devices, connectors, pins, signals) and Harness (projects, signal rules). Switching it on installs them; switching it off leaves them, with all their records.
